title: Malta's 7,000-Body Underground Necropolis 🏛️
hook_sentence: Beneath the town of Paola, Malta, prehistoric builders engineered an ancient subterranean monument across three superimposed underground levels linked by steps and doorways.
narration_script: Beneath the town of Paola, Malta, prehistoric builders engineered an ancient subterranean monument across three superimposed underground levels linked by steps and doorways. Hollowed directly out of soft globigerina limestone, the underground chambers were carved entirely by hand using antlers and stone tools made of chert, flint, and obsidian. Archaeological records indicate that the underground necropolis originally contained the remains of approximately 7,000 individuals, utilized from around 4000 B.C. to 2500 B.C. Inside, a carved resonance niche in the Oracle Room creates an acoustic echo that carries sound throughout the chambers. Construction workers discovered the underground complex by accident in 1902 while cutting cisterns for new housing.
closing_sentence: Construction workers discovered the underground complex by accident in 1902 while cutting cisterns for new housing.
caption:
A three-level city of the dead lay hidden beneath Malta for thousands of years 🏛️

Prehistoric builders in Paola, Malta carved this subterranean monument across three superimposed underground levels using only antlers, chert, flint, and obsidian. The chambers held the remains of approximately 7,000 individuals, utilized from around 4000 B.C. to 2500 B.C. It remained unseen until 1902, when workers cutting cisterns broke through the rock ceiling.

Would you descend into an ancient underground necropolis carved entirely by hand? ⏳
